Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 9-1 at 3051 W Irving Park

Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                            ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 9-1 in the area bounded by


       West Irving Park Road; a line 107.12 Feet east of and parallel to North
       Albany Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West Irving
       Park Road; and a line 81.12 feet east of and parallel to North Albany
       Avenue,


to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.



Common address of property:          3051 West Irving Park Road

11.   Current Use of the Property: The subiect property was improved with a one and two-story
      mixed-use building. The mixed-use building was damaged by a fire and will be razed.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subiect
      property with a new three-story building that will contain retail space at grade and a total
      of three (3) residential units above.

13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
      dwelling unit number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
      space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC): The Applicant is proposing
      to develop the subiect property with a new three-story mixed-use building that will contain
      approximately 1.450 sq. ft. of retail space at grade and three (3) residential units above.
      The proposed mixed-use building will be masonry in construction and measure 40 feet in
      height. The proposed mixed-use building will be supported by three (3) surface parking
      spaces that will be located at the rear ofthe subiect lot.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
